name: MyPlateTrack
summary: Log your meals, explore food variety and plan your next grocery shop.
previewAlt: A saved MyPlateTrack lunch with foods grouped by category

platforms.name: Android

features.title: Your everyday plate
features.text: Keep a simple record of the foods you eat, by meal.

features.title: Your Boost foods
features.text: Choose foods you would like to eat more of, with source-linked food tips.

features.title: A bigger picture
features.text: Explore your food variety and Boost frequency over time.

features.title: Your next shop
features.text: Plan your groceries, then check off the list as you shop.

screenshots.alt: A saved lunch with foods recorded across food groups

platforms.notice: MyPlateTrack provides general food information, not medical advice. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent medical conditions.

name: MyPathoTrack
summary: Keep pathology results together, follow changes over time and remember planned tests.

platforms.name: Windows

features.title: Your results, together
features.text: Keep pathology results and notes in one place.

features.title: Changes over time
features.text: Follow markers across dates with trend charts.

features.title: Household profiles
features.text: Keep separate records and settings for each person.

features.title: Planned tests
features.text: See tests that are due soon or overdue based on the intervals you set.

platforms.notice: MyPathoTrack helps organise information; it does not diagnose, prescribe, provide universal target ranges or decide how often you should be tested. Your laboratory reports and clinicians remain the sources of clinical meaning.
